question: If three prime numbers, all greater than 3, are in A.P., then their common difference

options.A: must be divisible by 2 but not necessarily by 3
options.B: must be divisible by 3 but not necessarily by 2
options.C: must be divisible by both 2 and 3
options.D: need not be divisible by any of 2 and 3

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
